blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Bureaucratic delays at the Department of Health (DOH) slow down the implementation of hospital projects, with repeated approvals and paperwork preventing billions of pesos from reaching health facilities, Deputy Speaker Janette Garin said on Saturday. The Health Facilities Enhancement Program (HFEP) had used only 11% of its funds during the period examined in congressional budget hearings, Garin, a former secretary of the Department of Health (DOH), pointed out. “During the budget hearing from September to October, the DOH showed clearly that the utilization of the HFEP was only at 11 percent last quarter,” she said in Filipino during the […]...
